metadata.description: Animated themes for the Claude desktop app, one plugin per theme.

plugins.name: matrix-rain
plugins.description: Matrix rain: green code that drifts while idle, pours while Claude works, storms when it writes a lot, drops coloured streams on every tool call, and chimes when a reply ends. Over Claude's own background, in light or dark mode.

plugins.name: clockworks
plugins.description: Clockworks: an iron gear train that stands still and muted while idle, turns while Claude works, spins faster when it writes a lot, and rings a small bell when a reply ends.
